messages:
Maya (Marketing): Heads up — analyst pre-briefs next week. Tentative embargo lifts Wed 10:00am PT. Can we confirm slots and quote language? :eyes:
Eli (PR): I'll lock the calendar after we agree on embargo. Need final quote by EOD Tue to send to analysts for fact-checks.
Priya (Comms): Re: quote — legal flagged the phrase 'industry-leading throughput' yesterday. Suggest: 'measured throughput improvement vs default configs'.
Jonas (Product): Agree with Priya. Also updated benchmark numbers: median latency down 28% on our Dedicated config (see gist). Don't want to overclaim 3x unless we call out workload.
Maya (Marketing): Good catch. I'll draft quote with Jonas and Priya. @Zoe can we squeeze an extra brief at 9am PT for EU-friendly slot?
Zoe (Ops): 9am PT is doable but pushes our afternoon queue. We have one capacity for a last-minute analyst; need to confirm by 3pm PT Mon.
Eli (PR): Who's owning the fact-check package? Need OS licensing lines, model names, test harness link.
Jonas (Product): I'll export the benchmark runbook + config snippet. Paste below:
```
model: redwood-v1-finetuned
hw: 8xA100
batching: dynamic
seq_len: 1024
dataset: benchmark-suite-v3
```
Will attach the full perf CSV to the doc.
Priya (Comms): For quotes: 2 short options (one technical, one customer-focused). Maya please pick. Legal will review once I drop the two variants.
Maya (Marketing): Drafting now. Technical: "Our Dedicated config reduced median token latency by 28% on representative RL workload." Customer: "Customers saw meaningful latency improvements while lowering per-token cost."
Eli (PR): Nice. Add an attribution line: "— Maya Leung, Head of Marketing, Redwood Inference"
PressBot: Automated embargo reminder — embargo window set to 2026-03-24 10:00:00 PT. Fact-check deadline: 2026-03-23 17:00:00 PT.
Priya (Comms): We got a quick ask from Analyst X for raw numbers. Can we provide top-line CSV and note about anonymized client traces?
Jonas (Product): Yes, provide aggregated CSV + statement: "client traces anonymized per privacy policy". I'll redact any hostnames.
Zoe (Ops): Scheduling note: if embargo shifts later than Wed 10am PT, we need 12h notice to update media list.
Maya (Marketing): FYI — one analyst requested a live demo. Can we have a short demo script? 8–10 min, focused on latency and rollout UI.
Jonas (Product): I can run the demo. Will craft a 10-step script and a fallback video in case infra quirk.
Eli (PR): Sounds good. I'll prep the invite copy and include both quote variants + link to perf CSV. Send final assets by Tue EOD please. :thumbsup:
Maya (Marketing): Copy. I'll post the final package here when ready. Thanks team!"
